        <section class="hotel-landing__section hotel-landing__hero">
            <div class="hotel-landing__info">
                <div class="hotel-landing__stars-row">
                                            <div class="stars_icons">
                                                            <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/star.svg" alt="star">
                                                            <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/star.svg" alt="star">

                <h1 class="hotel-landing__name">HOTEL  JAGUARIBE LODGE</h1>
                <div class="hotel-landing__address">
                    <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/location_map_icon.svg" alt="location">
                    <span>Gleba 14, Praia Canoé - Fortim/Ce Pontal de Maceió, Fortim 62815-000</span>
                    <a class="hotel-landing__map-link location_maps" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#hotel_map">
                        See on Map                    </a>
                </div>
                <div class="hotel-landing__description">
                    The luxury of space, tranquility, and privacy in a stunning location, where nature, with its dunes, coconut groves, and mangroves, is omnipresent. Facing the Jaguaribe River, which opens into the ocean and offers an exceptional stretch of sea for learning to kitesurf, the Jaguaribe Lodge Hotel was built with utmost respect for the environment, seemingly floating above the dunes and the sea, via a series of walkways that leave the natural environment intact and provide access to the complex's various facilities. An international kite surf center, a restaurant with ocean views, a spectacular bar overlooking the acrobatics of professional kitesurfers, and a spa with massage rooms are also available. A semi-Olympic-sized pool with a bar and numerous relaxation areas are also available. We have 23 spacious bungalows built on stilts and wide open to the sea, all made of quality wood—a true immersion in nature, space, and unforgettable freedom.
                </div>
            </div>
